links.outcome: Deterministic verifier accuracy at flagging corrupted claims in a synthetic corruption benchmark
links.effect: 100% exact-set accuracy on 6,620-claim corruption benchmark; in 24-case LLM pilot, frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions.
links.quote: The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark.

links.outcome: Automated verification accuracy on AI-derived claims as predictive model performance degraded
links.effect: ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000.
links.quote: During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000.

Using LLMs only to structure explanations while deterministic verifier performs final evidence-consistency checking

screen.reason: The study develops and empirical evaluates a neuro-semantic verification guardrail to check LLM-extracted claims and explanations against patient-specific evidence records in glioblastoma radiogenomics.

primary.practice: deterministic neuro-semantic verification of AI explanations against evidence ledgers
